questions: What is access?
If access is granted, can someone still be unable to use it?
What is coverage?
If coverage is high, is everyone protected?
What is exposure?
If exposure is low, does anything show up?
What is a surge?
When a surge ends, is everything back to normal?
What is capacity?
If capacity is full, can anyone else be helped?
What is promotion?
If the promotion goes through, does someone move up?
What is a case?
When a case is closed, is it finished?
What is resilience?
If resilience is high, does everything return to exactly where it started?
What is surveillance?
If surveillance sees nothing, is there nothing to respond to?
What is risk?
If the risk is high, does it promise a bigger return?
What is spillover?
After spillover, does it keep spreading?
What is screening?
If the screening is clear, is everything fine?
What is immunity?
If immunity is granted, can the same threat still get through?
What is stress?
If the stress is released, does everything return to shape?
What is burden?
If the burden is lifted, is everything back to normal?
